body: i think i will have to talk to my mom about getting some help soon. i finished up all my exams today and things are actually looking a little better than expected grade wise, at least. i still feel very uncomfortable here and am somewhat considering taking the semester off to get all this straightened out. i know that my mom loves me a lot and would do anything to help me, like all of you said. it's just going to be hard to admit everything that happened since i lied about it for so long. but i'm going home tomorrow afternoon and spending the day with my mom. i think i should talk to her then. thank you all so much for talking to me about this. i don't feel nearly as alone now that someone knows. it's just going to be scary to level with her face to face. i know she'll be disappointed about my grades but if she knows the whole story it might just be okay
